name: MUTYH-related polyposis

criteria.description: Presence of biallelic pathogenic variants in the MUTYH gene
Presence of 10 to 100 colorectal adenomatous polyps
Family history consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance of polyposis
No pathogenic variants detected in the APC gene

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Biallelic MUTYH pathogenic variants plus presence of multiple colorectal adenomatous polyps
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is essential for confirmation; clinical presentation may overlap with attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis.

rare.symptomName: Congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium

laboratory: Elevated carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) in colorectal cancer
Histopathology showing adenomatous polyps with dysplasia
other: Family history consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance

distinguishingFeatures: Hundreds to thousands of colorectal polyps
Predominantly colorectal cancer without multiple polyps

redFlags: Development of colorectal cancer before age 50
Presence of multiple adenomatous colorectal polyps
Family history of polyposis or colorectal cancer with autosomal recessive pattern
references: Nielsen M et al. MUTYH-associated polyposis: clinical and molecular genetics. Clin Genet. 2017.
Orphanet: MUTYH-related polyposis. Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases, 2021.
Lynch HT et al. Hereditary colorectal cancer syndromes: molecular genetics, genetic counseling, diagnosis and management. Fam Cancer. 2015.
